understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete the level by activating all goal cells on the grid. A goal cell is completed by stepping onto it only when the carried piece exactly matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation. Completing every goal advances to the next level, and finishing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose a movement action (north/south/east/west). Walls can block movement, causing you to stay in place while still spending stamina. Moving consumes stamina; if stamina reaches 0 and you take another action, you lose a life and stamina resets, and losing all lives ends the game. The carried piece has three attributes—shape, color, and rotation—and stepping on modifier tiles changes them: shape modifiers cycle the shape, color modifiers cycle the color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. You must use these modifier tiles as needed to make your piece match the active goal requirements, then step onto the goal cell to complete it.
